scope: Read-only preseal review of V5 clipped RGB deblending, RAM chronology and the complete three-category external composition. The complete development result arrived during the review and its provenance and arithmetic were verified; no full scoring was rerun.

checks.dependency_closure: All local explicit Python imports reachable from the20 declared source/metadata paths are covered; no missing executable dependency or duplicate path found. Package initializers contain docstrings/version only and are additionally hashed here.
checks.clipping: Clipped candidate support is filtered only by absolute y>=18+full_origin_parity and y<194. Every remaining pixel must lie in the observed component; no crop is allowed at an arbitrary component boundary. Horizontal coordinates preserve torus connectivity.
checks.exact_cover: Both interior and clipped deblending compare all admissible pair explanations as ordered foreground and visible-background support sets. A single-glyph explanation, multiple distinct supports, or no explanation retains the original component. Pixels are neither dropped nor duplicated.
checks.ram_rgb_separation: RAM decoder accepts current RAM plus previous adjacent RAM only; player/missile uses current RAM, rocks use guarded chronology. RGB checker receives only the raw image; its caches are pure functions of image-derived shape data, with no RAM, episode or chronological input.
checks.continuity: Strict fixture reader verifies contiguous charged frames, episode changes and shard hashes. Scorer resets previous RAM at episode changes and copies current RAM after decoding every image; no image/phase subset is excluded from denominators.
checks.criteria: The unchanged cardinality-first Breakout matcher and all three frozen per-category99% thresholds are used, including all frames and union-positive frames separately. Minimum50 matches; empty fractions remain null/FAIL. All3 categories must pass, with no pooling.
checks.provenance: Complete result has exactly the20 declared source hashes, all equal current files. Capture provenance equals immutable manifest. Manifest SHA agrees with V5. Player/missile dictionaries exactly equal their earlier ROI-corrected diagnostic; every asteroid counter/fraction equals V5. Source hashes are checked before/after the production scoring loop.

independent_absolute_support_enumeration.result: PASS: independent absolute-coordinate enumeration gives exactly one foreground/background visible-support pair, equal to the implementation on every witness. Union/disjointness checked for every component in those six images; read shard SHA verified.
